svg.title: BLE remote lifecycle — remote ⇄ test jig
svg.text: BLE remote lifecycle — remote ⇄ test jig
Arrows show who transmits. The jig (xiao-test-tool) plays the role the TV / STB normally plays.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Remote

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: BLE peripheral

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Test jig (XIAO)

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: BLE central · stand-in host

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1 · First pairing

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Remote in pairing mode, STB off. One time per remote (per session for the Android TV voice remote).

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ADV_IND — connectable, LE-discoverable flags (PAIRING)

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: CONNECT_IND

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: SMP pairing — Just Works (both tested remotes: legacy pairing)

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: key distribution — LTK, IRK → bond stored on both sides

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2 · Link set-up

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Done by the jig on every connection.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: GATT discovery + reads (HID report map, Device Information, battery)

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: write CCCDs = subscribe (keys, battery, voice) · ATV: GET_CAPS

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ATV voice caps reply → link is LIVE

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3 · Idle

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Remote sleeps between events: interval × (slave latency + 1), e.g. 20 ms × 50 ≈ 1 s.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: empty link-layer packets keep the connection alive

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4 · Key press

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HID input report (notification) → Keys tab

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 5 · Voice (Android TV Voice v1.0, hold-to-talk)

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mic button held. Audio stops on release or at the 15 s cap.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: voice control: AUDIO_START

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: IMA-ADPCM 16 kHz audio · 20-byte notifications, ~400 /s

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: voice control: AUDIO_STOP

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6 · Reconnect after a drop or a jig reboot

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No pairing: encryption with the stored keys.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ADV_DIRECT_IND — directed at the jig's private address

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: CONNECT_IND + LL encryption with the stored LTK

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fire TV remote: keys continue. Android TV voice remote: link stays silent → pairing mode again (Ch. 7).

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Battery: read once after encryption, then the remote notifies on change (Battery Level 0x2A19).

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The Nordic sniffer can only watch such a link passively — once bonded it is encrypted (Ch. 9).
